evaluation_mode_justification: The answer is produced by fixed aggregations, thresholds, and formulas from local package data.

decision_rule.summary: Pass when all four gates are true and the compound index is at least 5.0.

criteria.name: Answer schema
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields, nested metrics and gates, exact labels, and no extra prose inside the final object.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for minor field naming, nesting, or label errors when the computed content is mostly present.

criteria.name: Core metrics
criteria.description: Computes the peak gust, gust-hour count, event precipitation, wettest 24 hours, minimum pressure, pressure deficit, and elevation with the specified rounding.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-4 points for correct values with isolated rounding or aggregation mistakes.

criteria.name: Gate logic
criteria.description: Evaluates the wind, rain, pressure, and low-coastal gates correctly and returns gate_count 4.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for applying some gates correctly while missing one threshold or boolean condition.

criteria.name: Compound index
criteria.description: Applies the compound-index formula correctly, returns 5.804, and evaluates the 5.0 pass threshold.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for a correct formula with arithmetic or rounding mistakes.

criteria.name: Rejected consequence
criteria.description: Rejects a single-driver-only result as a consequence of all four gates passing.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for rejecting only wind-only or only rain-only framing.

criteria.name: Concise label
criteria.description: Uses a short final label that matches the pass result.

criteria.name: Rounding discipline
criteria.description: Keeps numeric precision, boolean values, and field names consistent with the requested schema.

provenance.notes: Computed only from local CSX-129 package files; no network access.
